identity.title: ALMA-JELLY. I. High Resolution CO(2─1) Observations of Ongoing Ram Pressure Stripping in NGC 4858 Reveal Asymmetrical Gas Tail Formation and Fallback

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present new CO(2-1) observations (resolution $\sim$1" = 460pc) of the Coma cluster jellyfish galaxy NGC 4858 obtained from the ALMA-JELLY large program.

evidence.quote: We adopt a luminosity distance for Coma of 100 Mpc, corresponding to a scale of 1" = 0.463 kpc.

question.value: How do strong, highly-inclined ram pressure stripping, rotation and torques shape the asymmetric inner molecular gas tail of NGC 4858, and is there evidence for gas fallback?

evidence.quote: The relationship between highly-inclined winds, asymmetric inner tails, and fallback is an open question addressed by this work.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2021.1.01616.L.

channel widths of 3.8 km s$^{-1}$

The RMS of the cube is measured at $\sim 2.3$ mJy Beam$^{-1}$.

analysis_steps.goal: Characterize stellar disk (PA, ellipticity, inclination, Sersic)

method.value: Elliptical isophote fitting of Subaru R-band image and 1D Sersic fit; same for CO moment-0 profile

evidence.quote: We use the elliptical isophote analysis tool in GALPRIME, which has a modified wrapper for the PHOTUTILS algorithm

key_parameters.value: Northern region heavily masked to avoid NGC 4860 light

evidence.quote: We mitigate this contamination by heavily masking the Northern region of the image

fitting.value: Iterative isophote fit of centre, PA, ellipticity, a3, a4; 1D Sersic profile

evidence.quote: We fit a 1D Sérsic profile model to the light distribution of NGC 4858.

analysis_steps.goal: Azimuthal/quadrant analysis of CO distribution and tail angle

method.value: Elliptical annuli with stellar PA/ellipticity; median flux in theta +/-5 deg; tail angle from LOFAR flux bisection; four quadrants

evidence.quote: We then take the median flux in regions of $\theta \pm 5\degree$.

key_parameters.value: theta_wind = -15 deg equally divides radio flux at 18-27 kpc

evidence.quote: We find a position angle of of $\theta_\text{wind} = -15\degree$ equally divides the radio continuum flux at distances 18-27 kpc, and adopt this as the tail angle.

analysis_steps.goal: Fit circular rotation model and obtain velocity residuals

method.value: 3DBarolo on moment-1 with fixed stellar PA, inclination, centre, Vsys; extend with tanh rotation curve; subtract model from moment-1

evidence.quote: We fix these parameters, as well as $x_0$, $y_0$, and $V_\text{sys}$ and assume no radial velocities.

key_parameters.value: Vmax = 165 km/s from Tully-Fisher; rt free, best fit 2.4 kpc

evidence.quote: Our best-fit to the available datapoints from $^\mathrm{3D}\textsc{Barolo}$ returns a transition radius of $r_t=2.4$kpc
